path.data-text: Word processor for DOS, Windows 3.x and Windows 95
Word processor for DOS, Windows 3.x and Windows 95
Quill 0.1.0
Demo release · A Liminal HQ Labs experiment
One word processor for DOS, Windows 3.x and Windows 95, written in Rust. Type a letter in
blue-screen DOS, where bold is bright white and italic is cyan. Save it, open it in the Windows 95 build,
and it has its fonts again. Quill's RTF opens in LibreOffice too.
DOS text mode, in DOSBox
Windows 3.11, in DOSBox-X
Windows 95, in DOSBox-X
Fonts, sizes, bold, italic, underline and colour
Tab stops with dot leaders, and lists
Headers and footers with page numbers
Find and replace, undo and redo
Spelling in Canadian, US or UK English
Its own .QLD files, RTF and plain text
Runs on
386 · 4 MB · VGA or text
Windows 3.x
Windows 3.1 or 3.11
Windows 95
95, 98 or Me · Pentium
Run in emulators, virtual machines
and Wine only, never on real
